ips_versions.author: Isabel
ips_versions.summary: Updated for the house purchase and a higher liquidity need.

parts.title: Client goals and objectives
parts.body: Buy a S$15m home within 12 months (S$3.0m deposit). Retain lifetime income and leave a legacy for two children.

parts.title: 3L buckets and explanation
parts.body: Liquidity 70%, Longevity 20%, Legacy 10%. Buckets move money to the near-term deposit while keeping long-term income.

parts.title: Client risk profile
parts.body: Balanced. Risk limit 3 of 5. Risk capacity: Moderate. Can tolerate a 12% drawdown; needs high liquidity for 12 months.

parts.title: Strategic Asset Allocation
parts.body: Cash 15, Fixed income 35, Equities 30, Hedge funds 5, Private markets 3, Real estate 5, Gold 7.

parts.title: Review rules
parts.body: Quarterly review. Rebalance when an asset class drifts more than 5 points from SAA. Benchmark: 40/60 blended index.

parts.title: Signature line
parts.body: Signed by RM after client confirmation (G1).
